title: The Nocturne page lives at /themes/nocturne and the theme picker says Nocturne; /themes/midnight redirects
detail: Daniel released the Midnight to Nocturne pins (2026-10-28). The feature page and its sample site moved to /themes/nocturne and /themes/nocturne/demo, with permanent redirects from the /themes/midnight addresses (next.config.ts). SITE_THEMES now labels the theme Nocturne everywhere the picker reads it. The id, the Midnight editor value and every saved site style stay `midnight`, so House of Fates and stored themes are untouched. themePagePath in lib/themes/library.ts is the one place that maps the id to its address. Pins rewritten with his words: site-style.test.ts label, the gallery and demo render tests, the midnight-feature-page and midnight-demo probes.

verify.evidence: lib/themes/library.ts maps midnight to /themes/nocturne; next.config.ts redirects the old address.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");const l=f.readFileSync("lib/themes/library.ts","utf8");const n=f.readFileSync("next.config.ts","utf8");if(!l.includes("themePagePath")||!n.includes("/themes/nocturne")){console.error("the Nocturne address or its redirect is gone");process.exit(1)}'
